# Serverless 配置文件
# 用于配置云函数、触发器等

service: shanhaijing-weather

provider:
  name: tencent
  runtime: python3.10
  region: ap-guangzhou
  credentials:
    secretId: ${env:TENCENT_SECRET_ID}
    secretKey: ${env:TENCENT_SECRET_KEY}

functions:
  generateWeatherData:
    handler: src.functions.generate_weather_data.main_handler
    name: generate-weather-data
    description: 定时生成天气数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        OPENWEATHER_API_KEY: ${env:OPENWEATHER_API_KEY}
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每25分钟执行一次
      - timer:
          name: weather-data-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0/25 * * * * *"
          enable: true

  generateStaticData:
    handler: src.functions.generate_static_data.main_handler
    name: generate-static-data
    description: 生成静态数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30

  generateStarrySkyForecast:
    handler: src.functions.generate_wonder_forecast.main_handler
    name: generate-starry-sky-forecast
    description: 每日生成星空预报数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        wonder_type: starry_sky
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每天凌晨2点执行
      - timer:
          name: starry-sky-forecast-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0 2 * * * *"
          enable: true

  generateSunriseForecast:
    handler: src.functions.generate_wonder_forecast.main_handler
    name: generate-sunrise-forecast
    description: 每日生成日出预报数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        wonder_type: sunrise
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每天凌晨2点执行
      - timer:
          name: sunrise-forecast-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0 2 * * * *"
          enable: true

  generateSeaOfCloudsForecast:
    handler: src.functions.generate_wonder_forecast.main_handler
    name: generate-sea-of-clouds-forecast
    description: 每4小时生成云海预报数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        wonder_type: 云海
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每4小时执行
      - timer:
          name: sea-of-clouds-forecast-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0 0/4 * * * *"
          enable: true

  generateTidalBoreForecast:
    handler: src.functions.generate_wonder_forecast.main_handler
    name: generate-tidal-bore-forecast
    description: 每4小时生成江潮预报数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        wonder_type: 江潮
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每4小时执行
      - timer:
          name: tidal-bore-forecast-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0 0/4 * * * *"
          enable: true

  generateGoldenMountainForecast:
    handler: src.functions.generate_wonder_forecast.main_handler
    name: generate-golden-mountain-forecast
    description: 每日生成日照金山预报数据
    memorySize: 128
    timeout: 30
    environment:
      variables:
        wonder_type: 日照金山
    events:
      # 定时触发器，每天凌晨2点执行
      - timer:
          name: golden-mountain-forecast-timer
          cronExpression: "0 0 2 * * * *"
          enable: true

package:
  include:
    - src/**
  exclude:
    - .git/**
    - .trae/**
    - __pycache__/**
